page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with line numbers (5, 10, 15 and so on) printed in the text column at the left. Catchword at the lower right, gathering signature at the lower left. Running head at the top.

main_text.l: e) salutarem vsam[?] bonorum huius mundi.
main_text.p: 10 a) Esa.54.v.5. Coniux tuus erit opifex tuus, cuius nomen Dominus exercituum.

Hos.2.v.16.19.20. Eritq; die illo, dictum Iehoua, vt voces me, Vir mi. Et desponsabo te mihi in seculum: desponsabo te, inquam, mihi iustitia, iudicioq; & benignitate ac misericordia; & desponsabo te mihi fide, vt agnoscas Dominum.
Iohan.6.v.56. Qui edit carnem meam, & sanguinem meum bibit, in me manet, & ego in eo.
1.Cor.7.v.17. Qui adhaeret Domino, vnus cum eo spiritus est.
Eph.5.v.30. Membra sumus corporis eius (Christi) ex carne eius & ex ossibus eius.
1.Cor.10.v.17. Vnus panis vnum corpus multi sumus.
2.Cor.11.v.2. Aptaui vos, quos vni viro, vt virginem puram si-stam, nempe Christo.
Gal.3.v.28. Omnes vos vnus estis in Christo.
25 Coloss.3. v.15. Vocati estis in vnum corpus.
Iohan.6.verf.54. Qui edit carnem meam, & bibit sanguinem meum, habet vitam aeternam.
Ioh.15.v.4. & seqq. Manete in me, & ego in vobis manebo. sicut palmes non potest ferre fructum à semetipso, id est, nisi manserit in vite: ita nec vos, nisi in me manseritis, &c.
Rom.18.verf.17. Si filij, sumus etiam haeredes, haeredes quidem Dei, coharedes autem Christi.
Eph.4.v.3. & seqq. Studete conseruare vnitatem spiritus per vinculum pacis. Vnum est corpus, & vnus spiritus: sicut & vocati estis in vnam spem vocationis vestrae. Vnus Dominus, vna fides, &c.
1.Iohan. 1. v.5. & seqq. Hic est nuncius ille, quem audiuimus

page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed in the text column at the left and are kept where they stand. The numbers at the far left edge of the scan belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. "vsam" in item e) is hard to read at this resolution and may be "vitam"; marked [?]. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The catchword "exipso," and the signature "Z 4" are at the foot of the page.
